$child = detachedLeaf27(); $parent = detachedParent27(); echo "P|"; $parent->rewind(); $child->next();
echo "V|", $parent->current() instanceof DetachedCache27 ? "HELD|" : "BAD|", "K|", $parent->key() === null ? 1 : 0, "|";
